# DDES · Diseño de Estructuras y Soluciones S.A.S. (English)

> Structural engineering firm based in Barranquilla, Colombia, founded in 2020. Structural design under the NSR-10 (Colombia's seismic-resistant building code), independent design review, technical supervision and construction oversight (Law 1796 of 2016), structural assessment and retrofit, and BIM coordination, in Colombia's Caribbean region and the rest of the country. The team works in Spanish.

Contact: gerencia@ddes.co · WhatsApp +57 300 202 1920 · https://ddes.co/en/contact/
Spanish version (the original): https://ddes.co/llms.txt

## Main pages

- [Structural engineering services in Colombia](https://ddes.co/en/services/): Structural engineering services in Colombia under the NSR-10: structural design, construction oversight, technical supervision, design review, retrofit and BIM.
- [Law 1796: does your project need a design review?](https://ddes.co/en/law-1796/): Law 1796 requires an independent design review and technical supervision when the lot allows more than 2,000 m². Check online what your project needs.
- [Free NSR-10 tools: seismic hazard and design spectrum](https://ddes.co/en/tools/): Look up the seismic hazard of all 1,117 municipalities in Colombia, calculate the NSR-10 design spectrum and check what Law 1796 requires of your project. Free.

- [Insights: technical notes on NSR-10 and Law 1796](https://ddes.co/en/insights/): Technical notes by DDES on the structural problems we see on site in Colombia: the NSR-10, Law 1796, earthquakes, soils, durability near the sea and site QA.
- [Contact: talk to a structural engineer in Colombia](https://ddes.co/en/contact/): Talk to DDES about a project in Colombia: WhatsApp, a short form or a call in Spanish. An engineer replies with a proposal. gerencia@ddes.co, +57 300 202 1920

## Services
- [Structural design in Colombia to the NSR-10 code](https://ddes.co/en/service-structural-design/): Structural design in Colombia under the NSR-10: buildings, warehouses and infrastructure, with signed calculations and drawings and support through the permit.
- [Construction oversight (interventoría) in Colombia](https://ddes.co/en/service-construction-oversight/): Interventoría in Colombia: independent construction oversight on the owner's behalf, controlling quality, schedule and cost, with monthly reports and minutes.
- [Independent technical supervision, Law 1796 Colombia](https://ddes.co/en/service-technical-supervision/): Independent technical supervision in Colombia (Law 1796), mandatory when the lot allows over 2,000 m². Site visits before every pour and the report for the CTO.
- [Independent structural design review in Colombia](https://ddes.co/en/service-design-review/): Independent structural design review in Colombia (Law 1796), mandatory when the lot allows over 2,000 m². Comments against the NSR-10 and a signed statement.
- [Structural assessment and seismic retrofit, Colombia](https://ddes.co/en/service-assessment-and-retrofit/): Structural pathology, seismic vulnerability studies (NSR-10, chapter A.10) and retrofits for existing buildings in Colombia: cracks, corrosion, settlement.
- [Structural BIM coordination in Revit for Colombia](https://ddes.co/en/service-bim-coordination/): Structural BIM coordination with architecture and building systems: clashes are resolved in the model before construction. Revit, Navisworks, model quantities.
- [Adding a second floor: structural design and permit](https://ddes.co/en/second-floor-addition/): What you need to add a second floor to your house in Colombia: assessment of the structure, NSR-10 vertical extension (A.10.8) and permit drawings.
- [Structural retrofit of houses and buildings (NSR-10)](https://ddes.co/en/home-structural-retrofit/): When to retrofit an existing house or building in Colombia, what NSR-10 Chapter A.10 requires and how it is done: assessment, tests and intervention design.
- [Structural crack assessment for walls and beams](https://ddes.co/en/crack-assessment/): Cracks in walls, beams or slabs in Colombia: when they are serious, what causes them and how a structural assessment with diagnosis and repair is done.
- [Structural design of warehouses in Colombia](https://ddes.co/en/warehouse-structural-design/): Structural design of warehouses in Colombia: frames, roof, wind loads (NSR-10 B.6), floor slab and foundation, from the team behind Centurión and Cannon.
- [Retaining wall design under the NSR-10 code](https://ddes.co/en/retaining-walls/): Retaining wall design in Colombia for basements, level changes and sloping lots: soil study, earth pressure, drainage and NSR-10 Chapter H.6.
- [Structural design of water tanks and swimming pools](https://ddes.co/en/tanks-and-pools/): Structural design of buried and elevated water tanks and pools in Colombia under NSR-10 Chapter C.23: watertightness, crack control and durability.
- [Steel mezzanine design for warehouses and stores](https://ddes.co/en/steel-mezzanines/): Structural design of steel mezzanines in Colombia: NSR-10 live loads (B.4.2), steel beams and columns, the existing slab and foundation, and erection.
- [Building permit in Colombia: structural requirements](https://ddes.co/en/building-permit-structural-requirements/): Which structural documents the curaduría asks for a building permit in Colombia: soil study, signed drawings and calculations, and Law 1796 review.

## NSR-10 tools (free)
- [Free NSR-10 tools: seismic hazard and design spectrum](https://ddes.co/en/tools/): Look up the seismic hazard of all 1,117 municipalities in Colombia, calculate the NSR-10 design spectrum and check what Law 1796 requires of your project. Free.
- [NSR-10 seismic hazard by municipality: Aa, Av, Ae, Ad](https://ddes.co/en/seismic-hazard/): Look up any municipality in Colombia and get Aa, Av, Ae, Ad and its seismic hazard zone from Appendix A-4 of the NSR-10, with the design spectrum ready to open.
- [NSR-10 design spectrum calculator: Sa, Fa, Fv and TC](https://ddes.co/en/design-spectrum-nsr10/): Calculate the NSR-10 elastic acceleration spectrum (A.2.6) for any municipality in Colombia: Fa, Fv, importance factor, T0, TC, TL, Ta and Sa, with a chart.
- [Law 1796: does your project need a design review?](https://ddes.co/en/law-1796/): Law 1796 requires an independent design review and technical supervision when the lot allows more than 2,000 m². Check online what your project needs.

## Technical notes
- [Interventoría: construction oversight in Colombia](https://ddes.co/en/article-construction-oversight-interventoria/): Interventoría in Colombia: what construction oversight on the owner's behalf is, what it covers, when it is required and how it differs from supervision.
- [Structural design in Colombia: what the NSR-10 asks](https://ddes.co/en/article-structural-design-in-colombia/): Structural design in Colombia: who signs it, what drawings and calculations must contain under the NSR-10 (A.1.5), and what goes to the curaduría.
- [Seismic vulnerability study under the NSR-10 code](https://ddes.co/en/article-seismic-vulnerability-study/): What a seismic vulnerability study is, when the NSR-10 requires it (chapter A.10), what it includes and how to read its overstress and flexibility indices.
- [NSR-10 soil profile: site classes A to F explained](https://ddes.co/en/article-soil-profile-site-class/): The NSR-10 soil profiles A to F (site classes): how a lot is classified with vs, N or su in the top 30 m, and how the profile changes the design earthquake.
- [August 10, 2026 earthquake: what failed in Cali](https://ddes.co/en/article-case-study-cali-earthquake-2026/): The magnitude 7.4 earthquake of August 10, 2026 in Cali: why buildings collapsed, what the first findings say about older codes and soil, and what it teaches.
- [August 10, 2026 earthquake: lessons from Pereira](https://ddes.co/en/article-case-study-pereira-earthquake-2026/): Pereira after the August 10, 2026 earthquake: buildings that survived 1999 but were never strengthened, and an airport closed by nonstructural damage.
- [One- and two-story houses under NSR-10 Title E](https://ddes.co/en/article-one-and-two-story-houses/): What Title E of the NSR-10 requires to build one- and two-story houses in Colombia: foundations, confined masonry walls, openings and tie columns and beams.
- [Geotechnical study: NSR-10 borings and their depth](https://ddes.co/en/article-geotechnical-study/): How many borings, and how deep, the NSR-10 requires in a geotechnical study: building categories, the minimums of table H.3.2-1 and depth set by the foundation.
- [Concrete near the sea: NSR-10 rules against salt air](https://ddes.co/en/article-concrete-and-salt-air/): Concrete near the sea under the NSR-10: exposure class C2, a 0.40 water-cement ratio, 35 MPa and minimum covers. The code's recipe for the Caribbean coast.
- [Concrete cylinder tests: NSR-10 acceptance rules](https://ddes.co/en/article-concrete-cylinder-tests/): When the NSR-10 accepts concrete: how many cylinder samples to take, how strength tests are evaluated, and what happens when a result comes out low (C.5.6).
- [Seismic hazard on the Caribbean coast, city by city](https://ddes.co/en/article-seismic-hazard-caribbean-coast/): Seismic hazard on Colombia's Caribbean coast under the NSR-10: Barranquilla, Cartagena and Valledupar are low; Santa Marta, Montería and Riohacha intermediate.
- [NSR-10 occupancy groups: why schools are stronger](https://ddes.co/en/article-occupancy-groups/): NSR-10 occupancy groups I to IV and their importance factors: why schools and hospitals in Colombia are designed for up to 50% larger forces than a home.
- [Story drift: how much a building may move, NSR-10](https://ddes.co/en/article-story-drift/): Story drift under the NSR-10: the limit of 1% of the story height in concrete and steel, why it matters, how it is controlled and what the reviewer checks.
- [Existing buildings: NSR-10 assessment and retrofit](https://ddes.co/en/article-existing-buildings/): When the NSR-10 requires an existing building to be assessed and strengthened: changes of use, extensions, structural alterations and earthquake damage (A.10).
- [Technical supervision under NSR-10 Title I: records](https://ddes.co/en/article-technical-supervision-title-i/): Technical supervision under Title I of the NSR-10: its minimum scope, the written record it must keep for five years and the final certificate it signs.
- [Nonstructural elements in the NSR-10: walls, facades](https://ddes.co/en/article-nonstructural-elements/): Nonstructural elements in the NSR-10: walls, facades and building systems designed for earthquakes, three performance levels and the exemption on the coast.
- [Earthquakes in Barranquilla: what the NSR-10 requires](https://ddes.co/en/article-earthquake-risk-barranquilla/): Are there earthquakes in Barranquilla? The NSR-10 places it in a low seismic hazard zone (Aa 0.10), and soil, wind and salt air also weigh on the design.
- [Design review vs technical supervision in Colombia](https://ddes.co/en/article-design-review-vs-supervision/): Independent design review and technical supervision under Law 1796: one checks the designs before the permit, the other the works on site. How they differ.
- [Certificado Técnico de Ocupación (CTO) in Colombia](https://ddes.co/en/article-certificate-of-occupancy-cto/): The Certificado Técnico de Ocupación (CTO) in Colombia: who signs it, when Law 1796 requires it and why it depends on supervising the works from the first pour.
- [When is a crack dangerous? A guide for owners](https://ddes.co/en/article-cracks/): How to tell a cosmetic crack from one that needs a structural engineer: width, direction, where it appears and whether it grows. A practical guide for owners.
- [Chlorides and reinforcement: the cover that protects](https://ddes.co/en/article-chlorides-in-concrete/): Why the sea breeze corrodes reinforced concrete from the inside, and what to specify against it: low-permeability concrete, generous cover, good curing.
- [Expansive clays in SW Barranquilla: foundations](https://ddes.co/en/article-expansive-clays/): Expansive clays in southwest Barranquilla swell in the rainy season and shrink in the dry season. Why they crack buildings and how foundations deal with them.
- [Law 1796: when technical supervision is mandatory](https://ddes.co/en/article-law-1796-explained/): Law 1796 of 2016 (Safe Housing Law): when technical supervision is mandatory, the 2,000 m² threshold, who can supervise and what the curaduría asks for.
